# Bundled Go dependency notices

Generated from the modules used by cmd/craft. License texts are copied unmodified from the pinned module cache. The CLI includes these dependencies; database servers are not bundled.

The unmodified MPL-2.0 MySQL driver source is available as the [v1.10.1 source archive](https://proxy.golang.org/github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql/@v/v1.10.1.zip). Source for every pinned module is available through its module path and Go module proxy; see go.mod/go.sum in the Craft source repository.
